Name: Lively Farmer Home
Author: Alvadea
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/70aebUA.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/br9RloX.png[/img][/center]

[color=#c9b490][size=3][center] "Lively Farmer Home" changes the look of the farmer house to a more detailed and enlivened version, while still staying close to the vanilla art style. It comes with seasonal changes.

And what's quite unique: it also has versions for rainy days and even for the rare green rain. [/center][/size][/color]
[color=#c9b490][size=3][center] [/center][/size][/color]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/5qAnYs3.png[/img][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3] "Lively Farm Home" replaces the houses.png. Every other mod doing the same thing will be incompatible. (Surprise...)

"Lively Farmer Home" comes with 4 different color versions to match the following recolors:

DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour
Starblue Valley World Recolor
Vibrant Pastoral Recolor

Change the style within the config to [b]Vanilla[/b] (default),[b] Earthy[/b], [b]Pastoral[/b] or [b]Starblue[/b].

[/size][/color][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8eSmNii.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png[/img][/center]

[*] [color=#c9b490][size=3]Download and install the latest version of[/size][/color][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url][/size]  
[*] [color=#c9b490][size=3]Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[code]Lively Farmer Home[/code]' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/size][/color]
